settings.label: Inverse logo
settings.info: Used on dark backgrounds

settings.content: Logo width (desktop and mobile) is set on the Header section itself in the theme editor — click Header under Header group. Max 300px.

settings.label: Hide price until customer logs in
settings.info: For wholesale/trade stores. Shows a "Sign in to see price" message instead of the price, and replaces Add to cart with a sign-in link, on product cards and the product page. This only hides the price in the storefront UI — it is not a security control (the price can still be reached via the cart or checkout by a determined visitor). For real B2B price gating, use Shopify's B2B/wholesale features or an app.

settings.label: Enable pre-order
settings.info: Add the tag below to any product (with "Continue selling when out of stock" turned on for its variants, in Shopify admin) to mark it as available for pre-order. Shows a "Pre-order" badge, swaps the Add to cart label, and shows a note on the product page.

settings.label: Pre-order tag
settings.info: Product tag that triggers pre-order mode. Case-insensitive.

settings.label: Product page note
settings.info: Shown below the buy button. Override per product with a "Preorder note" metafield (namespace: custom, key: preorder_note, single line text).
settings.default: This item is made to order and ships within 2–4 weeks.

definition.label: Input border
definition.info: Outlines form fields and buttons. Needs 3:1 contrast against the background so the control's edge stays visible (WCAG 1.4.11).

settings.label: Success color
settings.info: Used for fulfilled orders and successful status messages.

settings.label: Error color
settings.info: Used for form errors and validation messages.

settings.label: Show breadcrumbs
settings.info: Applies to product, collection, and blog post pages.

settings.label: Show savings tag
settings.info: Shows on product cards and the product page price when an item is on sale.

settings.label: Savings text
settings.info: Shown before the value, e.g. Save $20

settings.label: Button corner style
settings.info: Applies one consistent shape to primary and secondary buttons. Choose Custom to use separate radius settings.

settings.label: Background color
settings.info: Leave blank to use the active color scheme's button color.

settings.label: Text color
settings.info: Leave blank to use the active color scheme's button text color.

settings.label: Background color
settings.info: Leave blank for a transparent outlined button.

settings.label: Text color
settings.info: Leave blank to use the section's text color.

settings.label: Border color
settings.info: Leave blank to use the text color as the border.

settings.label: Show currency flags
settings.info: Adds a flag emoji next to each option in currency selectors (header and announcement bar).

settings.content: JSON-LD structured data helps search engines display rich results for your products. Products already output price, availability, SKU, brand, and reviews. These settings add optional data Google recommends.

settings.label: Return policy page URL
settings.info: Link to your published return page. Adds MerchantReturnPolicy to product offers.

settings.label: Return window (days)
settings.info: Number of days customers have to return items.

settings.label: Return policy country (ISO code)
settings.info: Two-letter country code (e.g. US, GB, DE). Defaults to your store's country.

settings.label: Animation
settings.info: Plays after an item is added. All options are automatically skipped for customers who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Show cart count bubble
settings.info: The small number badge on the cart icon. Turn off for a clean cart icon with no count.

settings.content: Choose how line items are arranged on the cart page. Customers can also switch between Grid and List at any time — their choice is remembered for next visit.

settings.label: Default layout view
settings.info: Customers can override this from the layout switcher on the cart page.

settings.label: Line items to show per page
settings.info: If your cart has more items than this, a 'Load more' button appears.

settings.label: Smooth scroll to top when switching layout
Upsell layout
settings.info: Choose between a horizontal slider with arrows or a clean grid without arrows.

settings.label: Upsell item style
settings.info: Grid: each item shown as a card. List: each item shown as a horizontal row with image left, details right.

settings.label: Show discount code field in cart
Cart total position
settings.info: Choose whether the cart total and checkout area appears above or below cart items in the cart drawer.

settings.label: Show cross-sell products in cart drawer
Manual cross-sell products
settings.info: Used only when the source is set to manually selected products.

settings.label: Require terms and conditions agreement
settings.info: Visitors must check this box before checking out, from both the cart page and the cart drawer.

settings.label: Terms checkbox label
settings.default: I agree with the Terms and Conditions

settings.label: Terms and conditions link
settings.info: Leave blank to use your shop's default Terms of Service page.

settings.label: Show savings badge on sale items
Popup style
settings.info: Choose the layout used when customers open Quick view.

settings.label: Card layout
settings.info: Use one clear card style across the store for a polished, consistent product grid.

options.label: Quick add — subtle plus on the image

settings.label: Card background
settings.info: Leave empty to use the theme background.

settings.label: Title lines
settings.info: Longer titles are cut with an ellipsis.

settings.label: Show product type above the title
Color option names
settings.info: Comma-separated option names rendered as color swatches.

settings.label: Size option names
settings.info: Comma-separated option names rendered as size pills.
settings.default: Size, Length, Width, Height, Waist, Shoe Size

settings.label: Always show Add to cart on touch screens
settings.info: Phones and tablets have no hover, so the button stays visible on the image.

settings.label: Product page layout
settings.info: Editorial and split-screen replace the gallery/media position settings below with their own fixed arrangement.

settings.label: Product image display
settings.info: Choose whether product images appear as a thumbnail gallery, stacked images, or a grid. Only used by the Classic product page layout.

settings.label: Thumbnail position
settings.info: Used only when Product image display is set to Show thumbnails. On small screens the rail always sits below the main image.

settings.label: Thumbnail style
settings.info: Visual style of the thumbnail rail on the Editorial and Split-screen product page layouts. Automatically switches to dots on small screens.

settings.label: Thumbnail arrow style
settings.info: Visual style of the scroll arrows on thumbnail rails.

settings.label: Arrow background color
settings.info: Background color for thumbnail scroll arrows (solid style only).

settings.label: Show floating add-to-cart bar
settings.info: Appears once customers scroll past the main add-to-cart button.

settings.label: Show selected variant
settings.info: Only shown for products with more than one variant.

settings.label: Show quantity selector
settings.info: Stays in sync with the quantity selector on the page. Requires the product page quantity selector to be enabled.

settings.label: Show close button
settings.info: Lets customers dismiss the bar. It stays hidden for the rest of the browsing session.

settings.label: Low stock threshold
settings.info: Show the stock counter when inventory falls at or below this number.

settings.label: Products per row
settings.info: Desktop. Tablet and mobile counts are set below.

settings.label: Words shown before Show more
settings.info: Longer descriptions collapse behind a Show more button.

settings.label: Show filters on search results
settings.info: Shopify only provides filters for product-only searches, so this has no effect while "Show collections", "Show articles" or "Show pages" is on.

settings.label: Show collections in results
settings.info: Matching collections are listed in their own column beside the product results.

settings.label: Button shape
settings.info: Applies to size/option buttons on the product page and size selectors on product cards.

settings.label: Border radius (used when shape is Rectangle)

settings.content: Paste the full profile URL for each network you use. Leave a field blank to hide that icon everywhere it appears — top bar, menu drawer, and footer.

For any network not listed above. Upload a square icon — a transparent PNG or SVG at 32×32 px (or 64×64 for retina) works best. Single-color artwork that matches your text color looks most at home; the theme scales it to the icon size set on each section.

settings.label: Custom icon 1 name
settings.info: Used as the link's accessible label, e.g. "Discord".

settings.label: Custom icon 2 name
settings.info: Used as the link's accessible label, e.g. "Discord".

settings.label: Custom icon 3 name
settings.info: Used as the link's accessible label, e.g. "Discord".

settings.label: Consent message
settings.default: We use cookies to enhance your experience and analyse site performance.

settings.content: For Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel and similar tracking, use Shopify's built-in Settings → Customer events instead of pasting code here — it's consent-compliant and keeps working if you switch themes. Use these boxes for anything Shopify doesn't have a native slot for (site verification tags, chat widgets, custom embeds).

settings.label: Header code
settings.info: Inserted just before </head> on every page.

settings.label: Footer code
settings.info: Inserted just before </body> on every page.
